text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...It's time for the paddock, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm going out there to show everyone
who I am right now.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: W-What intense excitement... I'm getting a little nervous...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose to anyone today.
Not even to the two of you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I know how capable she is. And how terrifying that can be.
Even so, I'm really looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Why did you go out of your way
to come declare something like that?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe it's because... for the first time,
I'm truly looking at all of you."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
Why don't you just do whatever you please, then?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I will simply do as I wish.
All I have to do... is prove that it is right.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't... want to lose either!
I look forward to racing with you...!
